ja: これが何をするのか知らない。
en: I don't know what this does.
alternatives: I have no idea what this does.
I'm not sure what this does.
point: what 節は平叙文の語順で what this does

ja: 面倒でも、この CLI は便利だ。
en: Although it's fiddly, this CLI is handy.
alternatives: Fiddly as it is, this CLI is handy.
It's fiddly, but this CLI is handy.
point: Although の後に but は不要

ja: ターミナル使うのが好き。
en: I like using the terminal.
alternatives: I enjoy using the terminal.
I love using the terminal.
point: like のあとは ～ing が自然

ja: Gitが私に面倒な手順を強いる。
en: Git makes me jump through hoops.
alternatives: Git makes me take unnecessarily complicated steps.
Git forces me through needless procedural hurdles.
point: jump through hoops は面倒な手順を踏まされる。

ja: 私はどのキーを押す？
en: Which key do I press?
alternatives: Which key should I press?
What key do I press?
point: which key で押すキーを尋ねる。

ja: この道具の安心感は見せかけかも。
en: This tool's reassurance may be more apparent than real.
alternatives: This tool may offer the illusion of reassurance.
The reassurance this tool offers may be illusory.
point: more apparent than real は実態より見かけの方が大きい。

ja: 必要なら私が導入するよ。
en: I'll install it if needed.
alternatives: I'll install it if it's necessary.
I'll put it in if needed.
point: if needed は必要な場合という条件を表す。

ja: 時短のため、エイリアスにした。
en: I aliased it to save time.
alternatives: I made it an alias to save time.
I set up an alias to save time.
point: 目的の to は「〜するために」。to save time

ja: ボットに再試行を頼んだ。
en: I asked the bot to retry.
alternatives: I asked the bot to try again.
I asked the bot to rerun it.
point: 「人に〜するよう頼む」は ask + 人 + to do

ja: そのプラグインはもう非推奨だ。
en: That plugin has already been deprecated.
alternatives: That plugin is already marked as deprecated.
They're already advising against using that plugin.
point: deprecated は使用を推奨しなくなったという意味。

ja: あとで更新するね。
en: I'll update it later.
alternatives: I'll do the update later.
I'm going to update it later.
point: その場で決めた未来は will

ja: 何を使ってる？
en: What do you use?
alternatives: What are you using?
What tool do you use?
point: 現在形の疑問は do you

ja: 私、これ変えられる？
en: Can I change this?
alternatives: Can I edit this?
Can I change it?
point: 「できる？」は Can I〜?

ja: 窓口は定型文で私をあしらった。
en: Support fobbed me off with boilerplate.
alternatives: Support brushed me off with canned replies.
Support dismissed me with stock responses.
point: fob off はその場しのぎの説明であしらう。

ja: 私は今設定を開いてる。
en: I'm opening settings now.
alternatives: I'm bringing up the settings.
I'm loading the settings now.
point: am opening で設定画面を開く動作中。

ja: 洗練されて見えてもこの道具は癖がある。
en: Polished though it seems, this tool has quirks.
alternatives: Although it looks polished, this tool has peculiarities.
This tool has idiosyncrasies despite appearing refined.
point: polished はよく仕上がっているように見える。

ja: 私が更新を許せばアクセスを失ったのに。
en: Had I let it update, I'd have lost access.
alternatives: If I'd let it update, I'd have lost access.
I'd have lost access had I allowed the update.
point: let + 動詞の原形を過去の反実仮想の条件に置く。

ja: 先月、CIを乗り換えた。
en: We switched CI tools last month.
alternatives: We changed CI tools last month.
We changed our CI last month.
point: 「乗り換える」は switch

ja: 環境構築に丸一日かかった。
en: Setting up my environment took all day.
alternatives: It took all day to set up my environment.
I spent all day setting up my environment.
point: 「構築する」は set up。動名詞が主語になる

ja: 設定はもう消えていた。
en: The settings had already vanished.
alternatives: The settings were already gone.
The settings had already disappeared.
point: 見つけた時点より前は had + 過去分詞

ja: あの更新は見かけ倒しかも。
en: That upgrade might be fool's gold.
alternatives: That upgrade may just seem worthwhile.
That upgrade might not be truly valuable.
point: fool's gold は価値があるようで実はないもの。

ja: 私はこのツールの癖を探ってる。
en: I'm exploring this tool's quirks.
alternatives: I'm studying this tool's unusual behavior.
I'm figuring out this tool's quirks.
point: quirks はツール独特の癖や挙動。

ja: このツールは無料です。
en: This tool is free.
alternatives: This tool costs nothing.
This tool is free to use.
point: 「無料」は free。形容詞なので be を使う

ja: 私が保存するよ。
en: I'll save it.
alternatives: I'll keep a copy.
I'll store it.
point: will で保存を引き受ける意思を表す。

ja: 遅いのはあのプラグインだ。
en: It's that plugin that's slowing things down.
alternatives: That plugin is what's slowing things down.
That plugin is the one slowing things down.
point: It's 〜 that 〜 で原因を強調する

ja: このツールの扱いづらい所が分かる？
en: Do you know where this tool gets finicky?
alternatives: Do you know where this tool gets fussy?
Can you tell where this tool gets finicky?
point: finicky は細かい条件に敏感で扱いにくい。

ja: 確認してれば、時短できたのに。
en: If I'd checked, I'd have saved time.
alternatives: I could have saved time if I'd checked.
If I had checked, I'd have saved myself time.
point: 過去の反実仮想は if + 過去完了、would have

ja: 自動整形するツールが好き。
en: I like tools that auto-format.
alternatives: I like tools which auto-format.
I like tools that format automatically.
point: 人以外の関係代名詞は that

ja: この便利さが何を隠すか気になる。
en: I wonder what this convenience conceals.
alternatives: I'm curious about what this convenience hides.
I wonder what's hidden behind this convenience.
point: wonder what this convenience conceals は便利さの裏で何が隠れているか気になること。

ja: 最新版を入れたよ。
en: I installed the latest version.
alternatives: I've installed the latest version.
I installed the newest version.
point: 「最新」は the latest。the をつける

ja: 我々は設定いじらなきゃよかった。
en: We should've left well enough alone.
alternatives: We shouldn't have tinkered with the settings.
We should've left the settings untouched.
point: leave well enough alone は十分よい状態をいじらない。

ja: Vim は何年も使ってる。
en: I've used Vim for years.
alternatives: I've been using Vim for years.
I've used Vim for a long time.
point: 期間 for + 現在完了

ja: ターミナルを開いて。
en: Open the terminal.
alternatives: Please open the terminal.
Open a terminal.
point: 命令文は動詞で始める

ja: 一時的な回避策がある。
en: There's a temporary workaround.
alternatives: We have a temporary way around it.
A temporary workaround is available.
point: workaround は根本修正までの回避策。

ja: 私は自動保存が好き。
en: I like autosave.
alternatives: I like automatic saving.
I like having files saved automatically.
point: autosave はファイルを自動保存する機能。

ja: 私はずっと設定をいじってる。
en: I've been fiddling with the configuration.
alternatives: I've been tinkering with the settings.
I've been tweaking the settings.
point: fiddle with は細かくいじる感じを含む。

ja: 不満なのはツールの計画的陳腐化だ。
en: What rankles is this tool's planned obsolescence.
alternatives: This tool's planned obsolescence is what bothers me.
The planned obsolescence of this tool irritates me.
point: rankle は不満を残す、What と is の形で問題を強調する。

ja: 新しい方のツールが速い。
en: The new tool is faster.
alternatives: The newer tool is faster.
The new one is faster.
point: 比較級は -er

ja: 標準搭載のこのツールは重すぎる。
en: This tool bundled by default is bloated.
alternatives: This default tool has unnecessary bulk.
This bundled tool is needlessly heavy.
point: bloated は不要なものが多く重い状態。

ja: Node を更新し再ビルドした。
en: Having updated Node, I rebuilt it.
alternatives: After updating Node, I rebuilt it.
I updated Node, then rebuilt it.
point: 先に終えた動作は Having + 過去分詞

ja: 更新後に私は初めて隠れた代償を悟った。
en: Only after updating did I discover hidden costs.
alternatives: I discovered hidden costs only after updating.
Hidden costs became clear only after I updated.
point: Only after updating を前に置き、更新して初めて隠れた代償を知ったことを did I で強調する。

ja: 窓口は我々の試みが筋違いと言った。
en: Support said what we'd tried was beside the point.
alternatives: Support said our attempts were irrelevant to the issue.
Support maintained that our attempts were irrelevant.
point: beside the point は今の論点とは関係がない。

ja: 継ぎはぎしたこのツールは脆い。
en: This cobbled-together tool is brittle.
alternatives: This makeshift tool is fragile.
This patched-together tool breaks easily.
point: cobbled together は間に合わせで継ぎはぎした。

ja: 失敗したら、教えて。
en: Tell me if it fails.
alternatives: Let me know if it fails.
Tell me if it breaks.
point: if 節は未来でも現在形

ja: 設定が三つある。
en: There are three settings.
alternatives: We have three settings.
Three settings are available.
point: three の後は settings と複数形。

ja: 私は拡大できる。
en: I can zoom in.
alternatives: I can enlarge it.
I can make it bigger.
point: zoom in は画面の表示を拡大する。

ja: バグを一つ見つけたよ。
en: I found a bug.
alternatives: I've found a bug.
I spotted a bug.
point: 「一つ」は a。数えられる名詞

ja: ツールは既に自動停止してた。
en: The tool had already shut itself off.
alternatives: The tool had already stopped automatically.
The tool had already switched itself off.
point: had already shut itself off は過去の時点より前にツール自身が既に停止したことを表す。

ja: リンターをやめたら困るよ。
en: If we dropped linting, we'd struggle.
alternatives: If we quit linting, we'd struggle.
We'd struggle if we dropped linting.
point: 現在の仮定は if + 過去形、would + 原形

ja: キャッシュを消せば直ると言われた。
en: I was told clearing the cache would work.
alternatives: Someone told me clearing the cache would work.
They said clearing the cache would fix it.
point: 言われた内容の will は would にずらす

ja: 文字を大きくして。
en: Make the text bigger.
alternatives: Make the letters bigger.
Make the writing larger.
point: make + 物 + bigger で表示を大きくする。

ja: 君はこの設定を微調整すべき。
en: You should fine-tune this configuration.
alternatives: You should refine this configuration.
You ought to adjust this configuration carefully.
point: fine-tune は少しずつ調整して最適化する。

ja: 固定してれば、今は安定なのに。
en: If we'd pinned versions, we'd be stable.
alternatives: If we had pinned versions, we'd be stable now.
If we'd pinned it, we'd be stable now.
Had we pinned versions, we'd be stable now.
point: 過去の仮定+今の結果。pin は「固定する」

ja: 設定を更新してもらえませんか？
en: Would you mind updating the config?
alternatives: Could you update the config?
Would you mind updating the config file?
point: Would you mind の後は動名詞 updating

ja: 昨日の更新から、何も動いていない。
en: Nothing has worked since yesterday's update.
alternatives: Nothing's worked since yesterday's update.
Nothing has been working since yesterday's update.
point: 起点のある継続は現在完了、時点は since で示す

ja: バグに悩み私はツールを捨てた。
en: Plagued by glitches, I ditched it.
alternatives: Troubled by glitches, I abandoned the tool.
I dropped the tool because of persistent glitches.
point: plagued by は繰り返す問題に悩まされる。

ja: その時初めて、ログを確認した。
en: Only then did I check the logs.
alternatives: Not until then did I check the logs.
It was only then that I checked the logs.
point: Only then が文頭なら did I check の倒置

ja: 月曜からテストが不安定なんだ。
en: The tests have been flaky since Monday.
alternatives: Our tests have been flaky since Monday.
The tests have been unstable since Monday.
point: 「〜からずっと」は現在完了 + since

ja: 依存が逃げ道を奪うと知っておけばな。
en: I wish I'd known dependence would leave no recourse.
alternatives: I wish I'd realized dependence would remove my alternatives.
If only I'd known dependence would leave no recourse.
point: recourse は困った時に頼れる別の手段。

ja: メニューがない。
en: There's no menu.
alternatives: No menu is available.
We don't have a menu.
point: there is no でメニューがないことを伝える。

ja: 彼がツールの拒否理由を知るか疑問。
en: I doubt he knows why it balked.
alternatives: I'm not sure he knows why it refused.
He may not know why the tool balked.
point: balk は要求に抵抗して動かない、doubt の中に疑問節。

ja: Gitが気まぐれじゃなきゃな。
en: I wish Git weren't so temperamental.
alternatives: If only Git weren't so unpredictable.
I wish Git behaved more consistently.
point: temperamental は機嫌に左右されるように不安定。

ja: 試すには Docker が要るよ。
en: You need Docker to test it.
alternatives: You'll need Docker to test it.
To test it, you need Docker.
point: 目的は to + 動詞の原形。for testing ではない

ja: 私は古い設定を移した。
en: I migrated the old settings.
alternatives: I transferred the old configuration.
I moved the old settings over.
point: migrate は設定などを別の環境へ移す。
